observations.what: After the first email step the site sent me to a second 'Sign up here' page asking for the same email again before showing a CAPTCHA.
After the CAPTCHA cleared, the page dropped back to the very first 'Get started with your work account' form with the email empty, so I had to enter it a second time.
The 'Welcome!' confirmation page said to check email, but no verification mail arrived in about 6 minutes of waiting.
The 'Click here if you don't see the email' link opened a generic help-center article instead of offering a resend button.
The signup page offered only work-email entry plus Google/Microsoft/Apple, with a data-region dropdown that I had no guidance on choosing.
I did not notice the signup had reset after the CAPTCHA and had to re-enter the email, costing two steps.
